key_decisions: THE PREVIEW CONTRACT is a standing constraint on the whole MPI-424 set: every tool is visited, previewed, then applied - or the preview goes away. ONE seam: mountOptions() calls viewer.el.discardPreview() unconditionally and the viewer decides what to drop. MPI-382 was the FIRST card to extend discardPreview rather than the call site; MPI-368 and MPI-373 do the same.
Adjust sits BELOW Detect in the rail (user, 2026-08-03) - it acts on a mask that already exists, so the rail reads in the order the work happens.
A mode RADIO gates the sliders, not a toggle button. The panel must never show a slider that does nothing: the first thing the user did was grab an inert Outward handle.

MPI-431 decided the same day it was raised: fill holes IN THE APP and turn mask_fill_holes OFF in the workflows - both, not one. klein_t2i node 286 is deliberately left alone (its mask is built inside the workflow, where the fill is intended). mask_expand_pixels: 6 is still open.
Apply is a layer-wide one shot, so it takes mask._recordUndo() after the no-op guard. UndoStack.pendingLayer() was retired for this card and now has no consumer at all.
constraints: A class with `display` OUTRANKS the UA sheet's `[hidden] { display: none }`. That is how three slider rows ended up on screen when only one was live. Any panel that hides a row by attribute needs its own `[hidden]` rule.

Every Adjust preview frame derives from a pristine copy taken at tool entry, never from the previous frame. ONE snapshot is enough because the preview contract guarantees maskCanvas === manual minus subtract at that moment.
Apply CLEARS subtractCanvas - the preview already has the erases baked in, so leaving it would punch them twice.

The morph primitive is blur-then-alpha-threshold, MEASURED: r of 1/2/3/5/8/12 land exactly, r=50 lands at 47/54 (curvature). 8.7 ms per pass at 1536 square. Do not swap it for an SVG feComponentTransfer - that was tried on paper and beaten on measurement.

Every new mask tool registers in _MASK_TOOLS, TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY, TOOL_LABELS, the MpiHistoryTools group, js/shell/preloadStyles.js and js/components/types.js; MpiCanvas._methods is an ALLOWLIST and a missing name is undefined on el. tests/mask-tool-registry.test.cjs guards the first two.
Tests run as node --test "tests/*.test.cjs" with the quoted glob. The directory form dies on Node v24.
Files are CRLF in the working tree - a Node replace using a literal \n will silently miss. Assert a sabotage APPLIED before trusting a negative control.

OTHER HANDS ARE IN THIS TREE. uiZoom.js, hotkeyManager.js, hotkeyRegistry.js, mpi-hotkeys.js, init.js and MpiGalleryGrid.js are modified by someone else (looks like MPI-374). Commit by explicit pathspec only - never git add -A.

resume_prompt: You are picking up Cubric Vision work on branch master. The MPI-424 canvas tool family umbrella is two cards down of five: MPI-425 (taxonomy) and MPI-382 (Adjust) are both built and user-verified. MPI-382 sits at doing/validating with exactly ONE thing outstanding - the user has not yet felt the mirrored Inward slider (zero at the right of the track, growing leftward), which landed after his verification pass. Ask him to reload the renderer, look at it, and close the card on his word; do NOT move it to done without that. Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-424/brief.md first - it is the whole architecture and the chat it came from is gone - then tasks/MPI-382/plan.md and docs/masking-tools.md. After MPI-382 closes, the recorded order says MPI-368 (Shapes - ONE gizmo, TWO mounts, mask and paint) is next and needs mpi-create-plan; it has no plan file. But note MPI-431, raised out of MPI-382 and decided the same day: every masked-edit graph feeds the user mask into InpaintCropImproved with mask_fill_holes true and mask_expand_pixels 6, so a mask with a deliberate hole - an Adjust edge band, the thing the user actually wants for fixing edge errors - is refilled into a solid blob before the sampler sees it. The decision is recorded: fill holes IN THE APP (a Fill button in the Adjust panel) and turn mask_fill_holes OFF in the workflows, both, while LEAVING klein_t2i node 286 alone because its mask is built inside the workflow where the fill is intended. mask_expand_pixels 6 is still an open question the user leans toward removing. Until MPI-431 ships, every unusual mask shape the umbrella can now produce is destroyed on its way to the sampler - which is worth saying to the user before defaulting to MPI-368. Two standing traps to carry: a class with display outranks the UA [hidden] rule (that is how three slider rows ended up visible when one was live), and other hands are in this tree - uiZoom.js, hotkeyManager.js, hotkeyRegistry.js, mpi-hotkeys.js, init.js and MpiGalleryGrid.js belong to someone else, so commit by explicit pathspec only.
